comparison.objective: Open a magnetic 3D-printer door while stabilizing the light printer.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual bracing and hinge/catch opening, not coaxial tool insertion, hammer impact, or fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: Door stays fully open, printer remains still, and print/head are untouched.
comparison.reason: Although both coordinate two arms and protect surrounding equipment, the central abilities and outcomes differ. No spec versions or numeric motion/damage thresholds are supplied.
